Revenge of the Sea God

You stole the treasure. Now the sea wants it back!

How to Play

1

Roll the die and sail your pawn along the spiral path toward the Pirate Docks.

2

Land on a colored circle to answer The Sea God's question -- correct keeps the card, wrong sends it back to the deck.

3

Once you hold 3 cards, spend them to drop a whirlpool and pull back a rival -- watch out for whirlpools too.

4

Reach the Docks with all four habitat colors in hand to win.
